Place and style row and column names

Source: R/labels.R
calor_labels.Rd

Row names sit next to the cells, or outside the tracks on the chosen side; column names the same. The style applies to both and is inherited by the track names, so one call sets the typography of the whole figure. Anything added later with theme(axis.text = ...) still wins.

Usage

calor_labels(
  rows = c("auto", "left", "right", "none"),
  cols = c("auto", "top", "bottom", "none"),
  size = NULL,
  colour = NULL,
  face = NULL,
  family = NULL,
  angle = NULL
)

Arguments

rows

"auto", "left", "right" or "none". Auto keeps names on the side without tracks, else outside the right tracks.

cols

"auto", "top", "bottom" or "none". Auto puts names on the side without tracks, else below.

size

Text size in points.

colour

Text colour.

face

"plain", "bold" or "italic".

family

Font family.

angle

Angle of column names in degrees; row names stay horizontal.

Value

An object to add to a ggcalor() plot with +.

Examples

m <- matrix(rnorm(80), 10, 8, dimnames = list(paste0("g", 1:10), paste0("s", 1:8)))
ggcalor(m) + calor_labels(rows = "right", cols = "bottom", angle = 45, face = "italic")
